description: This file defines configuration classes for a plugin system within the WPEFramework project. It includes JSON-based configuration containers, nested classes for root configuration, and utility classes for settings. The file also manages external dependencies and provides mechanisms for parsing and handling plugin configuration data.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Main configuration class for the plugin, encapsulating various settings and nested configuration structures.

classes.name: Config::RootConfig
classes.description: Nested class representing root configuration parameters, including mode, locator, user, and remote address.

classes.name: Config::RootObject
classes.description: Helper class for JSON parsing of the root config object.

classes.name: Config::Setting
classes.description: Utility class for representing individual configuration settings with trace output.

methods.name: Config::DataPath
methods.description: Constructs a data path string based on a base path and class name.

methods.name: Config::PersistentPath
methods.description: Constructs a persistent storage path based on a base path and configuration postfix.

methods.name: Config::VolatilePath
methods.description: Constructs a volatile storage path based on a base path and configuration postfix.

methods.name: Config::IPV4UnicastNode
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the IPv4 unicast node for a given interface name.

methods.name: Config::IsSameInstance
methods.description: Checks if another Config instance refers to the same plugin instance based on locator and class name.
